title: ReCast: Attribution-Oriented Step Representation Learning for LLM-Based Agent Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.11334v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In LLM-based agent systems, failures can originate from early steps whose effects propagate through subsequent interactions, making their origins difficult to identify. To trace such failures back to their origin, failure attribution has been formulated as the task of identifying the earliest step responsible for the failure. Recent methods leverage LLM internal signals for failure attribution, typically using hidden states as step representations. We therefore conduct an empirical study to evaluate how effectively these representations distinguish root-cause steps from other steps and find limited separation. Motivated by this observation, we propose ReCast, a step representation learning method that transforms hidden states from a frozen LLM into attribution-oriented step representations. translated_title: ReCast：面向归因的LLM智能体系统步骤表示学习方法
translated_abstract: 在基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体系统中，失败可能源于早期步骤，其影响会传播到后续的交互过程中，导致失败的根源难以识别。为了将此类失败追溯到其源头，失败归因被定义为识别导致失败的最早步骤的任务。近期的方法利用LLM的内部信号进行失败归因，通常使用隐藏状态作为步骤表示。为此，我们开展了一项实证研究，评估这些表示在区分根因步骤与其他步骤方面的有效性，结果发现其区分能力有限。基于这一观察，我们提出了ReCast，一种步骤表示学习方法，它将冻结LLM的隐藏状态转换为面向归因的步骤表示。ReCast首先选择与归因相关的层，然后构建互补的模式特征与偏差特征，最后学习上下文化的步骤表示。
tldr: 该论文提出ReCast方法，通过选择归因相关层、构建模式与偏差互补特征，将冻结LLM的隐藏状态转化为面向归因的步骤表示，从而显著提升LLM智能体系统失败归因中对根因步骤的识别能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes ReCast, a step representation learning method that transforms hidden states from a frozen LLM into attribution-oriented representations to better identify root-cause steps in failure attribution for LLM-based agent systems.
